title: copper bogged
description: this mod adds bogged copper as a new resource with new weapons and blocks and a new wood type!
body:
![logo i guess](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69c17e5f387e43cacb28bdeebac18183c1355a2a_0.webp)
copper bogged is a mod that adds new tools armor blocks wood types and a new biome!
bogged copper is slightly better than netherite because it was strengthened by the bog to be very strong "at least thats the lore" it adds a new step of progression so you can flex on your friends!!
[the bog armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea9acd3b0526308499c221128c8a6a58c2e110dd.png)
i am planing on expanding this mod in the future by supporting more loaders and versions but it just got released so yeah
